credits.title: Cousin Isha
credits.overview: After being publicly humiliated and heartbroken when his lover marries someone else, Ajit, the son of a small-town sweet shop owner, hits rock bottom-until Isha, his bold and fashionable distant cousin, unexpectedly enters his life, turning his pain into a potential new beginning.

credits.title: Nayyi Navelli
credits.overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

credits.title: Phoolan
credits.overview: Follows an impoverished 17-year-old girl who becomes a famous outlaw and survives a brutal 48-hour siege when thousands of armed men trap her in a village.

credits.title: Nishaanchi 2
credits.overview: After another stint in jail, Tony finds that Rinku, his one true love and hope, has been taken by his brother Dabloo. This shocks him into reforming, but Ambika drags him back into crime, with Kamal on his trail. credits.title: Nishaanchi
credits.overview: Twin brothers, identical looks but different values, face brotherhood, betrayal, love, and redemption. Their paths weave through crime into a deeper story of human nature and its results.

credits.title: Sab Moh Maaya Hai
credits.overview: The film is a poignant father- son story set in Ujjain. Inspired by true life, it deals with the sensitivity of unemployment, the selfless love of a father, and the behaviour of a selfish son, with quirk and humour.

credits.title: Bawaal
credits.overview: Ajay Dixit, an ordinary history teacher in a high school, enjoys mini celebrityhood in his town courtesy of the fake image he has built. credits.title: Lust Stories 2
credits.overview: Four eminent Indian directors explore sex, desire and love through short films in this sequel to 2018's Emmy-nominated 'Lust Stories'.

credits.title: I Love You
credits.overview: Satya is a highly successful corporate executive who looks forward to a bright future with her fiancé, Vishal. One night, when she is about to board a flight to Delhi, Satya finds herself trapped within the office premises. What dangers await her?

credits.title: Sherni
credits.overview: A jaded forest officer leads a team of trackers and locals intending to capture an unsettled tigress while battling intense obstacles and pressures, both natural and man-made.

credits.title: Chousar Firangi
credits.overview: Youngsters from humble backgrounds get unwittingly dragged into the dirty world of politicians and gangsters, and must now devise a plan to escape from this dirty game in the course of a single night.

credits.title: Soni
credits.overview: Soni, a young policewoman in Delhi, and her superintendent, Kalpana, have collectively taken on a growing crisis of violent crimes against women. However, their alliance suffers a major setback when Soni is transferred out for alleged misconduct on duty.
